title: Operator State
description: Mutable per-install operator choices written by vrooli-onboarding (and editable by hand). Manifest data — what scenarios/resources/tools/safeguards exist and what they declare — lives in scenario service.json, resource.json, tool.json, and safeguard.json files. This file holds *what was selected on this install*: enabled flags, per-scenario auto-restart overrides, host-tool and safeguard opt-ins, and typed safeguard config values. Fields are optional; a missing config value falls back to the manifest's declared default.

version.description: Schema version of this operator-state document.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last write. Onboarding updates this on every save.

trust_posture.description: Per-install operator-selected trust stance. It selects token, break-glass, node-execution, and JWKS-cache defaults; it never disables identity verification. Missing means personal.

host_workload_posture.description: Operator-declared scope for workload reporting. It changes reporting, grading, and recorded detail, but never how declared, unmanaged, or abandoned workloads are classified. It is independent of trust_posture, which selects credential and node-execution defaults. Missing means vrooli_only.

update_control.description: Operator-selected host update policy. observe records drift, guard preserves declared coupled sets, and own is reserved for a future typed implementation.

operator_id.description: Stable identity reference returned by enrollment; never an access token.

identity_provider.description: The authority used during enrollment, such as scenario-authenticator.

session_mode.description: Local session policy selected at enrollment.

enrollment_reference.description: Opaque enrollment reference; it is not a bearer credential.

core.description: Operator-granted core-set authority used by control-plane fallback paths.

active_profile.description: Optional named profile this state was derived from (e.g. 'engineering', 'marketing'). Reserved for future use; null today. Profiles themselves are deferred — see docs/configuration/profiles.md.

scenarios.description: Per-scenario operator choices. Keyed by scenario name. A scenario absent from this map falls back to its manifest's `service.system_required` and `runtime.auto_restart_default` defaults.

enabled.description: Operator-selected enabled state. Overrides manifest defaults except where `service.system_required: true`, in which case this field is ignored (system-required scenarios are always enabled).

auto_restart.description: Operator override for runtime.auto_restart_default. When absent, the manifest default applies.

resources.description: Per-resource operator choices. Keyed by resource id (e.g. 'postgres', 'vault').

enabled.description: Whether the operator wants this resource installed and running on this host.

host_tools.description: Per-tool operator opt-ins. Keyed by tool name as it appears in tool.json manifests.

opted_in.description: Whether the operator has consented to install this host tool. Required tools (per the manifest's `required: true`) bypass this and are always installed.

host_safeguards.description: Per-safeguard operator opt-ins. Keyed by safeguard name as it appears in safeguard.json manifests. Safeguards modify host state, so opt-in is explicit; risk level (low/medium/high) on the manifest informs the operator's choice.

opted_in.description: Whether the operator has consented to apply this safeguard to the host.

config.description: Operator-selected values validated against the safeguard manifest's config schema.

completion.description: Durable evidence that the committed selection was applied successfully.

degraded_acknowledgement.description: Durable record that the operator accepted a specific set of degraded optional items. The digest names the exact set that was acknowledged, so an acknowledgement cannot authorise completion over a different gap later.

session.description: Durable onboarding wizard pointer shared by UI and headless surfaces.
